- [RLOW.1.5] **Source locations survive lowering.** Every beta and
  terminal node the compiler attributes to a pattern or rule carries a
  `LineSpan` atom naming the DS source line and column of that pattern or rule
  ([RDSC.14.3], [RDSC.14.3.6]), so a runtime diagnostic on such a node reports
  the author's source location. A node the compiler makes for itself carries
  none ([RDSC.14.3.6]).
